thread:
anna_pm: Quick sync — we need to finalize the private deployment roadmap for Q3. Customers pressing for clear dates on VPC control plane vs fully offline installers. Who can propose a pragmatic MVP?

mike_eng: short version: prioritize one surface for launch. We either ship managed VPC control-plane first or an installer for air-gapped setups. Doing both simultaneously will stretch the team.

sarah_sec: compliance guardrails: KMS/HSM integration mandatory, signed artifacts + offline checksum verification for air-gapped installs, audit logging with tamper-evidence, and documented data flows.

kevin_sales: two deals in flight: MedTech (must be air-gapped), FinOps (wants VPC control-plane + IAM). Both are near-term ARR. We need realistic timelines to share by next week.

raj_infra: packaging choices and quick effort estimates:
- helm + operator (fastest for k8s/VPC customers)
- offline tarball + installer script + preflight (medium effort)
- OVA/VM image with everything pre-baked (highest effort, needed for strict air-gap)

lina_cs: support constraints: preflight check is essential, plus idempotent upgrades. If upgrade story is brittle we'll get immediate escalations. Also want example answers for preflight prompts.

mike_eng: proposed phased plan:
Phase A (MVP): VPC control-plane (customer infra), helm/operator installer, KMS proxy support, basic audit logs, preflight script, docs and runbooks.
Phase B: offline installer (tarball) with bundled artifacts + checksum verifier, upgrade playbook.
Phase C: OVA/air-gapped delivery + formal validation matrix + long-lived upgrade validation.

anna_pm: good. We need concrete launch criteria for Phase A that we can present to Exec and pass to Sales.

sarah_sec: Phase A security acceptance checklist:
- completed threat model and mitigations documented
- KMS integration tested with AWS/Azure (and fallback guidance)
- audit logs stored tamper-evidently with retention policy
- SCA/vuln scans passed for images

raj_infra: Phase A infra acceptance:
- installer (helm/operator) validated on k8s 1.24-1.26 in staging
- HA & autoscaling documented with runbook
- basic latency & throughput SLOs validated (p95 target under 60ms in staged load)

lina_cs: customer success readiness:
- onboarding runbook + preflight sample answers
- support playbook for top 10 failure modes
- training session scheduled for support/solutions teams

kevin_sales: commercial items to deliver:
- draft SLA for Private (uptime, maintenance windows, support response)
- pricing appendix showing one-time install vs reserved capacity
- customer-facing timeline and what Phase A does/doesn't include

mike_eng: resources ask: allocate 1 infra engineer + 1 platform engineer full-time for 6 weeks to hit Phase A. Phase B needs a release engineer and packaging owner afterwards.

anna_pm: tradeoffs for stakeholders:
- Focus on Phase A first: fastest route to close FinOps deal, but MedTech air-gap will wait (risk).
- Parallel work on Phase B: increases time-to-Phase A by ~2-3 weeks but reduces risk of losing MedTech.

kevin_sales: prefer Phase A first to close FinOps ASAP. We can commit to Phase B timeline to MedTech as milestone-based.

sarah_sec: ok with Phase A first if Phase B commitment and security acceptance criteria for air-gap are drafted concurrently.

raj_infra: agree. Recommend a 4-week cadence checkpoint to re-evaluate Phase B slot.

anna_pm: consensus leaning to Phase A-first with committed Phase B planning. Action items:
- anna_pm: update PRD with phased plan & acceptance criteria (EOD today)
- mike_eng: implementation plan + resource request (due Tue)
- raj_infra: spike offline packaging options with rough ETA & cost (due Wed)
- sarah_sec: start Phase B threat model & checksum verification design (due Thu)
- lina_cs: draft preflight sample answers & support runbook outline (due Fri)
- kevin_sales: sync customers on chosen approach and set expectations (ongoing)

deploy-bot: scheduled staging rollout for private-controlplane/v1.0.0-rc2 on 2024-08-12 02:00 UTC

anna_pm: thanks all. We'll reconvene Tue 9am PT to review the implementation plan. If anyone has objections to the Phase A scope, flag here before EOD.
